expectation: Membrane/fibrous PDPN on lymphatic endothelium: thin lines or networks lining vessels in submucosa, muscle and serosa. Also scattered stromal/FRC-like cells, and rare, sparse in gut, with little signal in epithelium.
observed: A: thin bright linear tracks in the muscle/serosa layer and sparse bright dots in the mucosa, over a yellow haze that follows the muscle. B/C: mostly haze with a few small bright blobs. D: one irregular bright cell with fine processes. E1: scattered small bright cells and fibres; CD21 is saturated, so E2/E3 are uninformative.
why: Thin vessel-like lines and sparse process-bearing cells fit lymphatic/stromal PDPN, but contrast is low over broad haze and the CD21 partner panel is uninformative.
